landing.headline: Connect. Hire. Grow.
landing.support: The agriculture marketplace for farmers, laborers, and rural businesses — hire workers nearby, rent equipment, buy farm needs, and track government schemes in English or Telugu.

problem.title: Farm work still runs on word of mouth
problem.lead: Finding reliable laborers, equipment, and buyers should not depend on who you know in the village. Raitu Mitra brings hiring and farm commerce into one phone-first place.
points: Laborers struggle to find consistent work beyond informal networks
Farmers have no clear way to discover skilled, available workers nearby
Wages, skills, and work history stay opaque
Language and digital literacy keep many platforms out of reach

audience.title: Built for both sides of the field

farmer.title: Farmers & landowners
points: Search laborers within a set radius on map or list
Filter by skill, wage, rating, and experience
Send hire requests with dates, wage, and location
Pay via UPI or Cashfree, then rate the work

worker.title: Farm laborers
points: Showcase 30+ skills with proficiency levels
Set wage range and toggle availability in one tap
Accept or reject job requests as they come in
Track earnings, chat with farmers, and build ratings

register.title: Create your profile
register.body: Sign in with your phone, choose farmer, laborer, or both, and add village or farm details.

find.title: Find the right match
find.body: Browse nearby workers, equipment, and listings — or let smart matching suggest a fit.

hire.title: Hire and coordinate
hire.body: Send a request, chat in-app, and track the job from accept through completion.

pay.title: Pay and rate
pay.body: Settle with UPI or Cashfree, keep a payment history, and leave a rating for next time.

features.title: One marketplace for farm life
features.lead: Workforce, equipment, inputs, and schemes — not five different apps.

workforce.title: Workforce hiring
workforce.body: Radius search with GPS, AI smart match, and full hire tracking.
points: Default 25 km search, adjustable from 5–50 km
Skills across field work, livestock, equipment, and more
Status tracking from request to done

equipment.title: Equipment rental
equipment.body: Tractors, threshers, sprayers, and harvesters — with or without an operator.
points: Browse nearby machines with rates and photos
Book dates and get owner acceptance
Bundle tractor + driver in one request

marketplace.title: Farm marketplace
marketplace.body: Buy and sell groceries, inputs, property listings, and transport when you need them.
points: Category browse and search built for low bandwidth
Orders with chat and PIN completion
Platform Fee and Pay Now for smoother checkout

schemes.title: Government schemes
schemes.body: Discover schemes that matter to your farm and keep a personal shortlist.
points: Browse in English or Telugu
Save schemes you care about
Stay informed without hunting across portals

skills.title: 30+ skills across five categories
skills.lead: Laborers pick what they do best. Farmers filter for exactly what the season needs.

field.name: Field work
field.examples: Ploughing, sowing, weeding, harvesting, irrigation, transplanting, land leveling

animals.name: Animal husbandry
animals.examples: Feeding, milking, herding, veterinary assistance, poultry care

equipment.name: Equipment operation
equipment.examples: Tractor, thresher, pump, harvester, and sprayer operation

postHarvest.name: Post-harvest
postHarvest.examples: Sorting, packing, storage, transportation, drying and curing

specialized.name: Specialized
specialized.examples: Organic farming, soil testing, nursery, drip irrigation, mushroom cultivation

field.title: Designed for the phone in your pocket

bilingual.title: English & Telugu
bilingual.body: Switch language anytime. Screens, notifications, and help follow your choice.

nearby.title: Nearby by GPS
nearby.body: PostGIS radius search finds workers and listings around your village or farm.

chat.title: In-app chat
chat.body: Message about jobs and orders in real time, including image sharing.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.body: Smart matching and a chatbot for farm questions when you need a second opinion.
